verdicts.reason: A keeps the circle, can, headline, subhead and buttons grouped as in the original with clear hierarchy. But the whole block sits in the top ~60%, leaving a large empty orange band at the bottom. The NEW badge and Try It button are also cramped right under the subhead, and the CTA is undersized. B breaks the product art: the cream circle has come apart from the can and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner. The orange can blends into the orange background, the NEW badge is stranded in the top-right corner, and the headline is small. The headline, subhead and CTA float with arbitrary gaps and no shared alignment.
